title: Release notes gating, redaction, and owner briefings
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Create a repeatable, auditable workflow for releasing internal and customer-facing release notes that enforces gating (legal/security/engineering signoff), a lightweight redaction pipeline for sensitive content, and a short owner-ready briefing that PMs and SEs can use when engaging customers. Background: Recent dedicated and private deployments surfaced a few instances where release notes included operational details or third-party attributions that required late-stage edits and re-communications. That cost time and confused some enterprise customers. Scope: 1) Define the gating checklist and SLA for each gate (Draft -> Legal -> Security -> Engineering -> Comms) with explicit owners and a 48-hour review target for legal/security. 2) Author a redaction guide and automated pre-flight checklist (keywords, IP/third-party mentions, internal-only feature flags) and a process to create a redacted public summary plus an internal technical appendix. 3) Ship two templates: "Customer Executive Summary" (2–3 bullets, impact/cost/benefit) and "Technical Appendix" (owners, rollout notes, migration steps) plus a 1-page "Owner Briefing" (what to say, known issues, fallback messaging). 4) Embed links in the release PR and in the console release UI for quick access; ensure the release digest generation job picks up the correct final copy. Deliverables: - Gating checklist doc (Confluence) - Redaction guide and preflight checklist (markdown) - Three templates (Exec summary, Technical appendix, Owner briefing) - Signed-off process and contact roster - Short playbook for roll-forward communications if release notes change after publish Timeline: Draft by 2025-02-14, complete reviews and first pass redaction by 2025-02-19, finalize templates and handoff to Comms by 2025-02-22. Success metrics: - Zero post-publication legal redactions for the next three releases - 90% of release notes pass security/legal review within 48 hours - PMs report the owner briefing reduced pre-call prep time by 50% (survey). Out-of-scope: Full automation of redaction (we will use a semi-automated checklist and manual signoff for the first two releases). Risks and mitigations: - Risk: Legal/security capacity during heavy release weeks. Mitigation: Pre-schedule "review shifts" and provide concise diffs for reviewers. - Risk: Sensitive details accidentally included in PR descriptions. Mitigation: Add a PR template reminder and add the preflight checklist as a mandatory checklist item. Stakeholders and reviewers: - Legal: Priya Raghavan - Security: Ben Cho - Comms: Elena Morris - Engineering leads: runtime, dedicated, console - Support: customer success lead (for customer-facing language)
